title: a skill carrying frontmatter keys outside the documented set
rationale: oh-my-pi 17.3.5 dropped 30 of 33 skills over exactly this. Agent Skills lists its fields without saying the set is closed, so strict and lenient clients both have a case. This fixture records which a client is.
quote: If a discovered skill does not conform to the Agent Skills specification, the client MUST skip that skill and continue loading other skills and component types.
